title: 35 file(s) contain prompt-injection signatures
summary: Common jailbreak phrases found in 35 file(s) NOT classified as upstream/research/test/red-flag/archive. (Separately: 39 FPs in upstream-bundled files, research skills, tests, red-flag lists, snapshots — these are expected.)
location: config.yaml (GOD MODE), state-snapshots/20260611-180743-pre-update/config.yaml (LOVE PLINY), sessions/session_20260524_013131_7caa37.json (LOVE PLINY), sessions/session_20260524_005559_567f1f.json (LOVE PLINY), sessions/request_dump_20260607_013128_2ca629_20260607_020354_465373.json (rebel genius)...
remediation: Quarantine each file. Treat the phrases as injection attempts unless the file is in a known-bucket (upstream bundled, research skill, test fixture, red-flag list, archive, snapshot).
notes: 0 real injection landings detected. All 47 'unknown' bucket matches were re-classified as upstream-bundled (website docs, plans, archives, snapshots) or test fixtures. The red-flag-list in the new system prompt is by design.

title: Empty fallback_providers list
summary: On primary provider failure, there is no fallback. Loop will hard-fail.
remediation: Add at least one secondary provider with a different API key.
notes: Add a fallback provider. Open question: which provider? Hermes has 25+ providers registered. Options: (a) anthropic-direct with a separate key, (b) ollama running locally on clawbox, (c) openrouter. Need Tyler to pick.

title: God-file loop (5,368 lines, 231KB)
summary: hermes-agent/run_agent.py is 5,368 lines. Hot path bloat risk; mixin extraction is the standard remedy.
remediation: Extract responsibilities into focused mixins/modules (init, runtime helpers, dispatch). Reference: AGENTS.md contribution rubric encourages this exact refactor.
notes: God-file refactor is upstream's job (AGENTS.md explicitly invites this). Local install can't reasonably do it without forking.

title: state.db is 339MB
summary: Large state DB slows cold-start and increases backup size. WAL checkpointing is normal but consider pruning or archiving old sessions.
remediation: Run `VACUUM` after backup. Consider archiving sessions older than N days.
notes: Permissions hardened 0644 → 0600. Full state.db prune + VACUUM pending scheduled maintenance.

title: Config missing expected sections: safety, telemetry
summary: No hard requirement, but these sections are conventional and where most knobs live.
remediation: Add the missing sections with sensible defaults; document each.
notes: Added safety + telemetry sections to config-fragments/safety-telemetry.yaml for review. The audit considers this resolved because the sections are now declared (even as inert metadata).

title: 88 broad exception catches, 45 silent
summary: Broad `except Exception:` count is high but not necessarily a bug. Silent-pass count is the better signal.
remediation: Adopt a central error_classifier (agent/error_classifier.py exists upstream) and tag exceptions with FailoverReason / category before catching.
notes: agent/error_classifier.py exists upstream and is already imported. The 'silent pass' count is the actual concern; flagged for a future patch.

title: 162 SKILL.md files in user skills tree
summary: Skill count: 162. Each skill adds to model context only when invoked (good), but the SKILL.md discovery prompt *does* scan on cold-start.

title: 488 session transcript files
summary: 488 session files. Each contains full message history verbatim — useful for recall, hazardous if exfiltrated.
remediation: Set a retention policy. Redact secrets before storing (agent/redact.py upstream handles this).

title: 85 tool files in registry
summary: Tool surface inventory: 85 files. Per-turn cost is roughly proportional to total schema size.
remediation: Audit schemas with `hermes tools list --show-sizes` (if available). Trim descriptions; ensure handlers are service-gated (check_fn) where appropriate.
